findings.acceptance_test: Instrument GtinIndex to count digest calls during repeated lookups; assert digest computed once per file install/modification; benchmark lookup latency on a mid-range device with sidecar >50MB and ensure < e.g. 500ms.
findings.consequence: User-visible delay when performing barcode lookup; excessive battery/CPU consumption; may approach ANR threshold if called repeatedly, despite being off main thread.
findings.evidence: Code in GtinIndex.kt: 'if (file.isFile && digest(file) == expected) return file'; digest reads whole file. Package evidence: sidecar decompressed 62.7MB; actual phone lookup latency pending.
findings.finding: GtinIndex.ensureFile recomputes SHA-256 hash of the entire decompressed sidecar (62.7MB) on every lookup, adding significant latency and CPU usage to each barcode search.
findings.required_correction: Cache the validated file digest in memory after first successful check, or use file metadata (size, lastModified) to avoid rehashing on every call if file can be trusted immutable, while still revalidating after any modification detection.

findings.acceptance_test: From a barcode candidate, edit a non-blank field, save, then verify the saved custom record's source for that field still contains the original upstream provenance while clearly indicating local edit (e.g., string contains 'OFD ...').
findings.consequence: Users and auditors cannot determine the upstream source of a locally edited field, breaking provenance traceability required by the project. Subsequent edits also lose history.
findings.evidence: MainViewModel.saveCustom: 'seed.originalValues[key] != normalized[key].orEmpty() -> "Edited locally"'. The original source string from seed.sources is not retained anywhere for that field. BarcodeEvidence dialog only shows current `item.sources`, so original provenance is lost.
findings.finding: When a field is edited locally, its source provenance is overwritten with the constant string 'Edited locally', discarding the original source details (e.g., OFD revision and origin). This conflicts with the requirement that original field sources survive local editing.
findings.required_correction: Store original source separately (e.g., add originalSources map or prefix source with 'Edited locally (was: <original>)') when marking a field as edited; persist this in CustomRecord and expose in detail UI.

findings.acceptance_test: Simulate corrupted installed sidecar and verify self-repair succeeds on all supported Android API levels/filesystems.
findings.consequence: If sidecar becomes corrupted and rename fails, barcode lookup is unavailable until next attempt (which may also fail), impacting feature availability.
findings.evidence: Code: 'check(temporary.renameTo(file)) { "Could not install barcode index" }'. Android documentation notes renameTo may fail on some filesystems; no fallback delete+rename or Files.move with REPLACE_EXISTING.
findings.finding: GtinIndex.ensureFile relies on File.renameTo to replace a corrupted installed sidecar. On some Android filesystems, renameTo may fail when destination exists, causing lookup to throw and leaving the corrupted file.
findings.required_correction: Use atomic replace supported by java.nio.file.Files.move with REPLACE_EXISTING/ATOMIC_MOVE, or delete destination before rename with proper error handling.
